d:
Dance to the beats of the 'Ghagra' Song, Where Tabu, Kareena Kapoor Khan, and Kriti Sanon set the floor on fire! With the magical voices of Ila Arun, Romy, and Srushti Tawade, and lyrics penned by Juno & Srushti Tawade, Bharg's Music Recreation promises a party like never before!
In Cinemas On March29
Song Details :
Song Name: Ghagra
Original Composer, Singer, and Lyrics - Ila Arun
Music Recreated by - Bharg
Singers - Romy & Srushti Tawade
Lyrics - Juno & Srushti Tawade
